questions.question: Which baseball team secured a place in the 2026 World Series, reaching the championship round for the first time since 1982 by sweeping the Los Angeles Dodgers?
questions.explanation: The Milwaukee Brewers swept the NLCS against the Dodgers to reach the World Series for the first time in over four decades.
questions.context: 2026 Major League Baseball season: In baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers sweep the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS to advance to the 2026 World Series, their first since 1982.

questions.question: According to research published by RAS Techniques and Instruments, what unusual colour is the newly identified star designated WD J1330+6435?
questions.explanation: Astronomers announced the discovery of the first green star, named WD J1330+6435.
questions.context: Astronomers discover the first green star, WD J1330+6435, according to a study published by RAS Techniques and Instruments.

questions.story: Hungary–Ukraine relations, Accession of Ukraine to the European Union
questions.question: Which European Union member state withdrew its objections to Ukraine's EU accession negotiations following discussions over minority rights?
questions.explanation: Hungary agreed to remove its opposition to further EU accession talks after progress was made regarding the rights of ethnic Hungarians in Ukraine.
questions.context: Hungary–Ukraine relations, Accession of Ukraine to the European Union: Hungarian prime minister Péter Magyar and Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy agree to improve bilateral relations during a meeting in Brussels, Belgium, with Hungary lifting objections to further European Union accession talks for Ukraine following progress on ethnic Hungarian minority rights in Ukraine.

questions.question: Environment minister João Paulo Capobianco announced that deforestation in the Amazon had dropped to its second-lowest level since 1988 in which South American nation?
questions.explanation: Deforestation in Brazil's portion of the Amazon decreased to 5,796 square kilometres during the twelve-month period up to July 2026.
questions.context: Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest: Brazilian environment minister João Paulo Capobianco reports that deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest fell to 5,796 km (2,238 sq mi) in the year through July 2026, the lowest level since 1988 except for 2012.

questions.question: Italian lender UniCredit received regulatory permission from the European Central Bank to increase its ownership stake above 30% in which major German bank?
questions.explanation: The ECB granted UniCredit approval to build a stake exceeding 30% in Commerzbank, clearing the way for a potential takeover.
questions.context: The European Central Bank authorizes UniCredit to raise its stake in Commerzbank above 30% without an upper limit, allowing the Italian bank to proceed toward taking control of the German lender.
